sources.snippet: Supertonic 3 runs through ONNX Runtime, with 10 voices and 31 languages. Korean is the focus. Tiny APK, about 7 MB. The voice model is downloaded once from Hugging Face (Supertone, plus the int8 files at robbiemed/supertonic-3-int8), pinned to a commit and verified with SHA-256: compact int8: 190 MB full fp32: 401 MB compact int8: 190 MB

sources.title: Supertonic 3 — Lightning-Fast, On-Device, Multilingual TTS
sources.snippet: Supertonic 3 is a 99M-parameter open-weight text-to-speech model from Supertone. Runs on CPU via ONNX Runtime. No GPU. No cloud. No API. 31 languages.
